disambiguation: Not a two-way sync tool; it imports annotations from remote backups into the vault.
extras: Mobile is not supported. No two-way sync or deduplication across sessions.
intentEvidence: Import highlights and annotations from Moon+ Reader WebDAV backups into Obsidian.
